Only source limit flag=0 estimates emitted; upper/lower limits and unspecified flags omitted. Four significant figures; uncertainties are not inferred or invented. Column definitions: https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/API_PS_columns.html. Selected numerical facts formatted by Inspire; no images or article prose used. Default literature reference: Kunovac Hodžić et al. 2021; https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.2893K/abstract.
